prose: Tonight we welcome Joe Rupe to Vibe Rant. In addition to hosting his long-running radio style podcast, Lighting the Void, Joe's also the man behind The Fringe FM, a network of like-minded esoteric explorers. With years of experience examining the occult and expanded consciousness research, Joe brings a wide array of knowledge that will absolutely make for a fascinating mind meld.
